regions.name: Rural Areas
regions.where: Rural areas nationwide (the locator map shades all of Ukraine)

harvest.name: Winter wheat, rye and rapeseed harvest (autumn-sown; no rainy season drawn for its growing period)

planting.name: Winter wheat, rye and rapeseed planting (autumn-sown)

regions.notes: Only 'Peak Rainfall' (Jun-Jul) is shaded; spring-sown crops are linked to it. Lean box Jan-Apr. Winter crops: land prep Aug, planting Sep-Oct, harvest Jun-Jul. Hazards: frost Jan-Feb and Dec, flooding Mar-May, drought & fire mid-Jul to Sep. Livestock sales mid-Sep to Dec.

regions.name: Urban Areas
regions.where: Urban areas nationwide (Kyiv and other cities); no locator map for this block
regions.notes: Urban lean box Jan-Mar, matching high staple food prices and health & electricity peak expenses Jan-Mar. Labour migration to the EU May-Sep; remittances year-round, high in Dec.

assign.method: Rural/urban blocks are livelihood types; every oblast was mapped to rural (the agricultural calendar covers its land) and only the city units Kyiv and Sevastopol to urban.

transcriber_notes: All edges fall on month boundaries. The rural/urban split cannot be mapped to oblasts from the image; strongly urbanised oblasts (Donetska, Luhanska, Dnipropetrovska, Kharkivska, Zaporizka) and Crimea kept rural with medium confidence. Rain in Ukraine is not limited to the shaded peak; autumn-sown winter crops and tree fruit are linked to no rainy season.
